dedupe_keys.name: palestine completed buildings by use of building 2017 census pcbs

description: The Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics publishes counts of completed buildings by their use, from its 2017 census, on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The dataset gives the tables at three levels, the country, its regions and its governorates, each as CSV joined to a boundary Shapefile, together with one Excel workbook holding all levels; the file names identify the 2017 census and the administrative level. Coverage: the West Bank and the Gaza Strip as counted in 2017. Access: CSV, Shapefile and XLSX files on HDX, published in February 2020 and last modified in August 2023. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike; free. Caveats: the HDX page gives only the title and says the method is a census, so the use categories and definitions must be read from the files or from PCBS census documentation. Simulation uses are a pre-conflict baseline of the building stock by use for exposure, damage and reconstruction estimates at governorate level. Related records: the HOT OpenStreetMap buildings baseline for Gaza and the UNOSAT damage assessments.
name: Palestine completed buildings by use of building, 2017 census (PCBS)
